intro: A formative review of the A1 content. Use the results to choose what to study again.

texto: A formative test of the A1 content covered. It includes reading comprehension for each extension chapter; the score guides your review and does not by itself certify your CEFR level.
Each question shows its chapter so you can go back to the matching explanation.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 1. Saying your name

frase.texto: Je ___ Léa.

opciones.explicacion: Je m'appelle = my name is.
It goes with «tu».
It goes with «vous».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 1. You are speaking to an older man you don't know. What do you use?

opciones.explicacion: With unknown adults, «vous».
It is for friends and family.
It is the emphatic form of «tu».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 2. Negation

frase.texto: Elle ___ pas française.

opciones.explicacion: Elle n'est pas.
The verb is missing.
«ne» is missing.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 2. Which one is correct?

opciones.explicacion: The job goes without an article.
«un» is not needed.
For jobs, the verb «être» is used, not «avoir».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 3. How do you say «I am thirty years old»?

opciones.explicacion: Avoir + number + ans.
Age goes with «avoir».
«ans» is missing.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 3. Possessive

frase.texto: C'est Paul et ___ sœur.

opciones.explicacion: «Sœur» is feminine → sa.
It is for masculine.
It is for plural.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 4. Negation of «il y a»

frase.texto: Il n'y a pas ___ jardin.

opciones.explicacion: Pas de + noun.
After «pas» comes «de».
After the negation «pas», indefinite or partitive articles change to «de».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 4. Which one is correct?

opciones.explicacion: De + le = du.
It merges into «du».
«de» is missing.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 5. Reflexive verb

frase.texto: Je ___ lève à sept heures.

opciones.explicacion: Je me lève.
It goes with «tu».
It goes with «il» or «elle».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 5. How do you say «I never work»?

opciones.explicacion: Ne … jamais.
«Jamais» replaces «pas».
«Ne» must go before the conjugated verb.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 5. What time is «huit heures et demie»?

opciones.explicacion: Et demie = half past.
It would be «et quart».
It would be «sept heures et demie».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 6. Partitive

frase.texto: Je prends ___ pain.

opciones.explicacion: «Pain» is masculine → du.
It is for feminine.
It would be one specific loaf.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 6. Which one is correct?

opciones.explicacion: Quantity + de.
After «beaucoup» comes «de».
«de» is missing.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 7. Demonstrative

frase.texto: J'aime bien ___ robe.

opciones.explicacion: «Robe» is feminine.
It is for masculine.
It is for plural.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 7. Comparing

frase.texto: Ce sac est plus cher ___ cette veste.

opciones.explicacion: Plus … que.
Comparisons of superiority are built with «plus ... que», not with «de».
In French, comparisons of superiority use «que».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 8. How do you say «turn left»?

opciones.explicacion: Imperative.
That is to the right.
That is «go straight ahead».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 8. Transport

frase.texto: Je vais au travail ___ bus.

opciones.explicacion: En bus.
«À» is for vélo and pied.
For means of transport where you travel inside, the preposition «en» is used.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 8. How do you say «I know how to swim»?

opciones.explicacion: Skill → savoir.
No preposition.
Skills are expressed with the verb «savoir» followed by an infinitive, not with «être».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 9. Aimer + infinitive

frase.texto: J'aime ___ au tennis.

opciones.explicacion: Aimer + infinitive.
The infinitive is needed.
That is the past participle.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 9. Which one is correct?

opciones.explicacion: Months take «en».
With the months of the year the preposition «en» is used.
The months of the year take «en», not «à».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 9. Near future

frase.texto: Demain, je ___ voir mes parents.

opciones.explicacion: Je vais + infinitive.
The near future is formed with the present of the verb «aller», not «être».
«Avoir» is used for the passé composé, not for the near future.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 10. Passé composé

frase.texto: Hier, j'___ mangé au restaurant.

opciones.explicacion: J'ai mangé.
«Manger» takes «avoir».
It goes with «il» or «elle».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 10. Which one is correct?

opciones.explicacion: «Aller» takes «être».
It doesn't take «avoir».
The past participle is needed.

pregunta.texto: Listen. What does it mean?

piezas.audio: Hier, je suis allé à Lyon et j'ai visité un musée.

opciones.texto: Yesterday I went to Lyon and visited a museum.
opciones.explicacion: Two pasts: one with «être» and one with «avoir».

opciones.texto: Tomorrow I'm going to Lyon to visit a museum.
opciones.explicacion: It is past tense.

opciones.texto: Yesterday I went to Lyon and watched a movie.
opciones.explicacion: «Musée» means museum.

pregunta.texto: Put the words in order.

frase.texto: Je vais voir ma famille la semaine prochaine

piezas.traduccion: I'm going to see my family next week.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 5. How do you say «I am reading right now»?

opciones.texto: Je suis en train de lire.
opciones.explicacion: Être + en train de + infinitive expresses an action in progress.
It means «I'm going to read».
Demain means tomorrow, not right now.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 5. The proposed time works for you. What do you reply?

opciones.explicacion: It means «that suits me».
It means «I have to cancel».
It means «I'm late».

pregunta.texto: Ch. 9. What do you say to congratulate someone on their birthday?

opciones.explicacion: It is a birthday greeting.
It means «good luck».
It is used to congratulate someone on good news.

pregunta.texto: Ch. 10. What does «Je viens de finir» mean?

opciones.explicacion: Venir in the present + de + infinitive expresses the recent past.
It would be «je vais finir».
It doesn't express a habit.

opciones.explicacion: This is the information from the French sentence.

opciones.texto: In « maison », « ai » is pronounced like an open «e».
opciones.explicacion: That meaning belongs to another sentence in the chapter.

opciones.texto: « Eau » and « au » are usually pronounced the same way.
